roadmap.title: A torch on a pole protects the pole
roadmap.body:
Sinka already snaps a standing torch down into a wooden pole. The torch should now shield the pole it sits in.

What that shield covers is still open: only fire, so the Ashlands stop burning the pole out from under its own torch, or every kind of damage, or a share of it. Take the torch away and the protection goes with it.
